author: gartung
body:
#### PR description:

Adds `LibraryMemoryService` plugin which reports the sum of all shared library mapped memory and optionally for each shared library loaded at the `postModuleConstruction` transition. At the `postEndJob` it reports the mapped memory for each shared library loaded and the summary with the totals for all shared libraries. title: Add LibraryMemoryReport service and ProcSmaps utility for memory reporting
